reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025, FY2024: this statement does not present operating profit as gross profit less one operating-expense line (the bridge runs through further income and expense headings the panel does not carry), so the two-row identity does not apply; every figure is as filed. Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit does not hold in FY2024: this statement does not present gross profit as revenue less one cost-of-sales line, so the two-row identity does not apply; the figures are as filed.
